title: Mommy Is Human | Mommy Is Human Too Read-Along for Kids
desc:
Mommy Is Human (Where It All Begins), a Mommy Is Human Too read-along story with Jojo, Pip, Baby Bee, Biscuit and Mommy. The story is read aloud with the words on screen so little ones can follow along.

Covenant verse: "For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust." Psalm 103:14 (KJV)

Watch together with a grown-up. Grown-ups can find the books and the app on our parents channel, @MommyIsHumanToo.
